ByteAddressBuffer x : register(t0);
ByteAddressBuffer y : register(t1);
RWByteAddressBuffer outBuf : register(u0);

[numthreads(256, 1, 1)]
void main(uint3 gid : SV_DispatchThreadID, uint3 gtid : SV_GroupThreadID, uint3 grid : SV_GroupID)
{
    // Each thread processes 8 fp16 elements = 16 bytes = 1x uint4
    // Group processes 256 * 16 = 4096 bytes
    uint byteOffset = grid.x * (256u * 16u) + gtid.x * 16u;

    uint4 a = x.Load4(byteOffset);
    uint4 b = y.Load4(byteOffset);

    uint4 r;
    [unroll]
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    {
        uint ai = a[i];
        uint bi = b[i];
        float2 af = float2(f16tof32(ai & 0xFFFFu), f16tof32(ai >> 16));
        float2 bf = float2(f16tof32(bi & 0xFFFFu), f16tof32(bi >> 16));
        float2 sf = af + bf;
        r[i] = f32tof16(sf.x) | (f32tof16(sf.y) << 16);
    }

    outBuf.Store4(byteOffset, r);
}

ByteAddressBuffer y : register(t1);
RWByteAddressBuffer outBuf : register(u0);

[numthreads(256, 1, 1)]
void main(uint3 gid : SV_DispatchThreadID, uint3 gtid : SV_GroupThreadID, uint3 grid : SV_GroupID)
{
    // Each thread processes 2x uint4 = 16 fp16 elements = 32 bytes
    // Group processes 256 * 32 = 8192 bytes
    uint base = grid.x * (256u * 32u) + gtid.x * 16u;
    uint off0 = base;
    uint off1 = base + (256u * 16u);

    // Interleaved loads first to maximize MLP
    uint4 a0 = x.Load4(off0);
    uint4 b0 = y.Load4(off0);
    uint4 a1 = x.Load4(off1);
    uint4 b1 = y.Load4(off1);

    uint4 r0;
    uint4 r1;

    [unroll]
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
    {
        uint ai = a0[i];
        uint bi = b0[i];
        float2 af = float2(f16tof32(ai & 0xFFFFu), f16tof32(ai >> 16));
        float2 bf = float2(f16tof32(bi & 0xFFFFu), f16tof32(bi >> 16));
        float2 sf = af + bf;
        r0[i] = f32tof16(sf.x) | (f32tof16(sf.y) << 16);
    }

    [unroll]
    for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j)
    {
        uint ai = a1[j];
        uint bi = b1[j];
        float2 af = float2(f16tof32(ai & 0xFFFFu), f16tof32(ai >> 16));
        float2 bf = float2(f16tof32(bi & 0xFFFFu), f16tof32(bi >> 16));
        float2 sf = af + bf;
        r1[j] = f32tof16(sf.x) | (f32tof16(sf.y) << 16);
